description: Curated read-only topology views over notes and edges.

neighborhood.query: LET relation_filter = (IS_ARRAY(@relation) ? (FOR r IN @relation RETURN LOWER(r)) : []) FOR v, e, p IN 1..@depth ANY @root edges OPTIONS { bfs: true, uniqueVertices: "global" } LET rel = LOWER(e.rel || e.type || e.label || "") FILTER LENGTH(relation_filter) == 0 OR rel IN relation_filter SORT LENGTH(p.edges) ASC, (e.weight || 0) DESC, v.created_at DESC LIMIT @limit RETURN { node: { _id: v._id, _key: v._key, title: v.title, type: v.type, tags: v.tags, weight: v.weight }, edge: { _id: e._id, _from: e._from, _to: e._to, rel: e.rel, type: e.type, label: e.label, weight: e.weight }, distance: LENGTH(p.edges), direction: e._from == @root ? "outbound" : (e._to == @root ? "inbound" : "path"), path: p.vertices[*]._id }
neighborhood.description: Rooted relation neighborhood with edge evidence, distance, direction, and path coordinates.

path.query: FOR v, e IN ANY SHORTEST_PATH @from TO @to edges RETURN { node: { _id: v._id, _key: v._key, title: v.title, type: v.type, tags: v.tags, weight: v.weight }, edge: e ? { _id: e._id, _from: e._from, _to: e._to, rel: e.rel, type: e.type, label: e.label, weight: e.weight } : null }
path.description: Shortest relation path between two note ids with node and edge evidence.
